# RevokeToken — Example

## Request Example

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<RevokeTokenRequest xmlns="urn:ebay:apis:eBLBaseComponents">
  <RequesterCredentials>
    <eBayAuthToken>A3</eBayAuthToken>
  </RequesterCredentials>
</RevokeTokenRequest>
```


## Response Example

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<RevokeTokenResponse xmlns="urn:ebay:apis:eBLBaseComponents">
  <Ack>Success</Ack>
  <Timestamp>2019-11-04T17:42:00.657Z</Timestamp>
  <Version>1123</Version>
</RevokeTokenResponse>
```
